articles.title: Why Cowboys left too much meat on the bone in the red zone
articles.summary: The article analyzes the Dallas Cowboys' persistent offensive struggles, specifically focusing on "red zone play" and play-calling. It highlights how these aspects have been a consistent point of contention and criticism for the team over several years, suggesting a need to revisit past issues to comprehend their ongoing performance challenges.

articles.title: During World War II a US War Production Board memo accused the diamond cartel of intentionally risking Allied war production by refusing to release a stockpile of industrial diamonds America needed to machine its engines
articles.summary: During World War II, the U.S. War Production Board accused De Beers of hoarding industrial diamonds. This controversial move was reportedly aimed at protecting De Beers' monopoly, but consequently put vital Allied war factories at significant risk due to critical shortages. This historical incident underscores how corporate interests can conflict with national security needs during global conflicts, impacting crucial defence production.

articles.title: Effort to malign CJI and judiciary: Delhi HC orders removal reports claiming 75 judges went to London Badminton event
articles.summary: Justice Tejas Karia has directed the government to issue notifications requiring social media platforms, search engines, and digital publishers to remove, disable, and de-index specific objectionable content. This ruling underscores India's intent for stricter regulation of online intermediaries, aiming to control the spread of harmful information. It reflects the judiciary's increasing involvement in digital content governance and platform accountability.

articles.title: India news: Millions of students retake NEET amid protests
articles.summary: Approximately 2.2 million pre-medical students are preparing to retake the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET), a pivotal examination for medical college admissions across India. A strict dress code, including a no-closed shoe rule, is mandated for candidates. This significant re-examination highlights the rigorous standards and immense competition inherent in the nation's medical entrance system.

articles.title: Parag Parikh Large Cap Fund: RIL, ITC, and Infosys among top 10 stock holdings in May
articles.summary: The Parag Parikh Large Cap Fund reported Assets Under Management (AUM) of Rs 739 crore as of May 31, 2026. The article specifically highlights the fund's top 10 holdings, sourced from ACE MF. This financial update provides crucial insights for investors and market analysts tracking the performance and portfolio allocations of significant large-cap investment funds.

articles.title: CPI(ML) demands probe into Bhojpur firing case
articles.summary: A survey reveals 50% of American adults under 50 may get wrong medical advice from social media platforms like YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. This contrasts with England's significant public health success, having eradicated cervical cancer deaths in young women. The article highlights both the pervasive challenge of online health misinformation and the positive impact of effective health initiatives.
